findings.explanation: A large multi-paragraph block spanning teaching notes, W3C tracestate, and capacity planning is repeated verbatim three times at the end of detailedImplementation.
findings.quote: Teaching notes for platform auditors: archive weekly CSV exports of critical and high severity rows to a restricted observability_evidence index with change ticket references when lookup targets move.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate the text so the teaching notes and extended narrative appear only once.

summary: The use case provides high-quality technical depth on log-to-trace linkability, W3C Trace Context propagation, and Splunk APM Related Content integration, but detailedImplementation contains a three-times duplicated narrative section and prose fields retain automated template artifacts.
